maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from personal care, home health and hospice services for clients, not repair or upkeep of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Personal care is mostly paid by state Medicaid programs and agencies; hospice and home health are largely Medicare.

serial_acquirer.reason: Has repeatedly bought home care, hospice and home health companies (Ambercare, Arcadia, Tennessee Quality Care, Hospice of Virginia) to expand.

mission_critical.reason: Clients or payers can move to another licensed home care agency; personal care is fairly interchangeable, though care continuity matters.

notes: Mission-critical and serial-acquirer are judgment calls; Addus also grows through new branches and contracts.
